query_analysis.original_query: We are looking to develop a more energy-efficient approach to extract ethanol from a 95% azeotropic mixture. Any suggestions on alternative distillation or hybrid methods?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Research and propose innovative, energy-efficient techniques for ethanol extraction from a 95% azeotropic mixture, exploring alternative distillation or hybrid separation methods.

selected_agents.role: Lead the exploration of alternative separation methods
Analyze energy requirements and propose efficient solutions
Evaluate process feasibility and economic viability

communication_strategy.information_flow: Continuous exchange of separation method ideas and thermodynamic insights

clarification_questions: What specific energy-efficiency targets are you aiming for?
Are there any constraints on the type of equipment or technology that can be used?
